description:

description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This vital full-time role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting your expertise in both staff development and infection prevention. We are seeking a dedicated professional to enhance our team and ensure the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and staff.

In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, ensuring our nursing team is equipped with the latest knowledge and skills. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, conducting surveillance, developing policies, and providing essential training to prevent and manage infections within the facility. Your contributions will directly impact the quality of life for our residents and foster a safe working environment.

If you are an experienced Registered Nurse with a passion for education and a commitment to infection control, we encourage you to apply promptly. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact within a supportive and dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license
Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care
Strong communication and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
